record.paper_title: Steinberg Groups for Jordan Pairs - An Introduction with Open Problems
record.original_question: For split root graded Jordan pairs V, can van der Kallen's basis-free presentation method be generalized to treat the Steinberg group St(V, R) uniformly, in a way that avoids case-by-case distinctions among root-system types?

evidence.quote: The quoted papers all use the same method, pioneered by [vdK], namely a “basis-free presentation of St(V, R)”.
Can the method of [vdK] be generalized to treat St(V, R), V split root graded, in a case-free manner?

artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open research problem in the area of Steinberg groups for Jordan pairs. The Loos–Neher monograph and follow-up surveys describe basis-free presentations carried out type-by-type in the literature, but no uniform, case-free generalization of van der Kallen's method for arbitrary split root graded Jordan pairs is reported. Recent work (e.g. on locally isotropic Steinberg groups) addresses related questions but does not provide the requested uniform presentation.
